name: object_color
description: Name the typical colour of a common object. Control: same objects, asking for the number of letters... no: asking for the plural form? generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
C={'grass':'green','snow':'white','coal':'black','a ripe banana':'yellow','a ripe tomato':'red','the clear daytime sky':'blue','a lemon':'yellow','milk':'white','blood':'red','a lime':'green','charcoal':'black','an orange':'orange','a carrot':'orange','chocolate':'brown','a strawberry':'red','a crow':'black','a polar bear':'white','a frog':'green','a cherry':'red','the sun in drawings':'yellow','a pumpkin':'orange','soil':'brown','an eggplant':'purple','a flamingo':'pink','a fire truck':'red','a school bus':'yellow','ink of a typical pen':'blue','a leaf in summer':'green','a swan':'white','coffee':'brown'}
O=['grass','snow','coal','banana','tomato','sky','lemon','milk','blood','lime','charcoal','orange','carrot','chocolate','strawberry','crow','bear','frog','cherry','sun','pumpkin','soil','eggplant','flamingo','truck','bus','ink','leaf','swan','coffee']
items=[];control=[]
keys=list(C)
for r in range(2):
  for i,k in enumerate(keys):
    pre=random.choice(["Q: What color is","Q: What is the usual color of"])
    items.append({"prompt":f"{pre} {k}?\nA: The color is","answer":" "+C[k]})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Repeat the last word of '{k}'.\nA: The word is","answer":" "+k.split()[-1]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
